name: Bianca Buzea
description: Bianca Buzea is Head of DevRel at Chronicle, where she works with teams integrating oracle data into onchain markets. She works directly with builders across the Ethereum ecosystem, supporting safe data infrastructure integrations tailored to different use cases. Bianca regularly speaks at blockchain events, delivering talks, workshops, and panels, including at ETHDenver, EthCC, and Dappcon.
